interactions.summary: The reading enters Canto 20's anti-avarice invective, then has the speaking soul identify himself as the root of the dynastic plant choking Christendom.
Jiang identifies the speaker as Hugh Capet and explains him as the family root behind imperial-Vatican conflict and broad political disorder.
Hugh Capet narrates the rise and corruption of his line, condemns French predation, rehearses daytime and nighttime exempla around greed, and the mountain suddenly trembles.

claims.claim: Canto 20 casts greed as an ancient wolf whose endless hunger devours the world and prompts a plea for a coming force that will drive it away.
The speaking soul says he is the root of the plant overshadowing Christian lands so thoroughly that good fruit can scarcely rise from them.
Jiang identifies this figure as Hugh Capet and frames his lineage as a present political house whose conflict with the Vatican spreads disorder across the Christian world.
Hugh Capet's speech traces how his line moved from modest beginnings into rapine by lies and force and then into further predatory expansion.

The same speech denounces later French crimes through prophecy, including a Charles who comes with Judas's lance, a ruler who sells his daughter, and the fleur-de-lis making Christ's vicar prisoner at Anagni.

The greedy rehearse praise-worthy examples by day and anti-examples by night, cycling through figures like Pygmalion, Midas, Achan, Sapphira, and Crassus as moral pedagogy before the mountain trembles.

signature_moments.moment: Greed arrives not as a neutral vice but as an ancient wolf whose hunger keeps taking prey.
signature_moments.source_phrase: ancient wolf, whose power can claim more prey
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It gives the terrace of avarice its most memorable governing image.

signature_moments.moment: Hugh Capet names himself the root of an obnoxious plant shading all Christian lands.
signature_moments.source_phrase: the root of the obnoxious plant
signature_moments.why_it_matters: The dynasty becomes a single invasive organism rather than a list of bad rulers.

signature_moments.moment: The house is condemned as trafficking in the flesh of its own children.
signature_moments.source_phrase: It traffics in the flesh of its own children
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This is the sharpest compression of dynastic greed turning inward and cannibalistic.

chronology_notes.note: This packet records Jiang's June 26 use of Dante's anti-Capet invective as a live model of political greed spreading from one family root into world disorder.

uncertainty_notes.note: Jiang's rapid historical gloss on Hugh Capet and the Holy Roman Empire is somewhat compressed and should be treated as lecture framing rather than a fully precise historical taxonomy.
